name: VAT return (box layout of this pack)
legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 445, s. 39(1) — a taxable person lodges a VAT return for each tax period no later than fifteen calendar days after the end of the period; s. 39(2) — with the Comptroller, in the form the Comptroller prescribes (the Department's VAT return form was not read as a text); s. 41(1) — the tax is due by the due date for lodgement. The Department's FAQ makes the tax period a calendar month and asks for a return even with no transactions; the page "Taxes" gives the 15th of the month following the period for filing and payment.

deadline.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 445, s. 39(1) and s. 41(1) — the return is lodged within fifteen calendar days after the end of the tax period and the tax is due by the same date: for a month, the 15th of the next month (confirmed by the Department's page "Taxes"). Tax paid late bears a penalty of twenty percent of the amount unpaid (s. 41(3)) and, according to the Department, interest of 1.5 % a month; the penalties for a late return are not modelled. Permission to lodge late does not move the date of payment (s. 39(4)). Weekend roll-forward is not expressible

boxes.name: Standard-rated supplies (16 %), net of VAT
boxes.legal_reference: Taxable supplies at the standard rate (s. 8(3)(d)). Box number and label are this pack's own: the Department's form was not read as a text, so the boxes follow what the Act makes the tax payable carry — output tax less the input tax credit (s. 27, s. 29).

boxes.name: Accommodation supplies (11 %), net of VAT
boxes.legal_reference: Taxable supplies of holiday or hotel accommodation at the reduced rate (s. 8(3)(b)(i), (ii)).

boxes.name: Tourist services (11 %), net of VAT
boxes.legal_reference: Taxable supplies of diving, marine or land tour services and other services ordinarily provided to tourists at the reduced rate (s. 8(3)(b)(iii)).

boxes.name: Zero-rated supplies, including exports
boxes.legal_reference: Taxable supplies at zero percent (s. 8(3)(a); First, Second and Third Schedules); they stay on the return (the Department asks for a return even when there is no activity).

boxes.name: Exempt supplies
boxes.legal_reference: Supplies of the Fourth Schedule, reported for information; the input tax of what is acquired to make them is not deductible.

boxes.name: Total supplies
boxes.legal_reference: Sum of boxes 1 to 5 — the sum is this pack's reading, the form is the Comptroller's (s. 39(2)).

boxes.name: Total output tax for the period
Value of imports
boxes.legal_reference: Value of taxable imports of the period (s. 8(1)(b)).

boxes.name: Value of local purchases
boxes.legal_reference: Value of purchases from registered persons and others, net of VAT.

boxes.name: VAT paid on local purchases
boxes.legal_reference: VAT charged by suppliers on local purchases, recoverable (s. 29).

boxes.name: Total input tax credit for the period
VAT payable
boxes.legal_reference: Output tax less input tax credit when positive; due by the due date for lodgement (s. 41(1)).

boxes.name: VAT refundable
boxes.legal_reference: Input tax credit less output tax when positive. The Department's FAQ carries a credit of less than $100 forward and allows a refund after three consecutive months of credit; the Comptroller applies s. 44.
